Part A — Reverse-Order Teardown Checklist Start disabling CloudFront first (Global): Open CloudFront -> Distributions -> <dist-id>: Remove the associated WAF (reloop2-web) and detach reloop2-spa-rewrite / reloop2-api-prefix from the two behaviors. Click Disable (takes ~2–4 minutes while you delete the regional services below). EventBridge (ap-southeast-1): Open reloop2-sweep -> remove target reloop2-api -> delete rule reloop2-sweep. Monitoring & Alerts (ap-southeast-1): Delete CloudWatch alarm reloop2-lambda-errors. Delete SNS topic reloop2-alerts (and any confirmed subscriptions). Delete CloudWatch Log Groups /aws/lambda/reloop2-api and /aws/lambda/reloop2-post-confirmation. AI Processing (ap-southeast-1): Open Amazon Bedrock -> Guardrails -> delete reloop2-ai-guardrail (deletes DRAFT and Version 1). API Backend (ap-southeast-1): Delete HTTP API Gateway reloop2-api. Sign-up & Sign-in (ap-southeast-1): Open Cognito -> reloop2-user-pool: Under Branding -> Domain, delete domain reloop2-auth (or your suffixed domain prefix). Under Overview -> Delete user pool, uncheck/deactivate Deletion protection and delete reloop2-user-pool. Lambdas & IAM Roles: Delete Lambda functions reloop2-api and reloop2-post-confirmation (ap-southeast-1). Open IAM -> Roles -> delete reloop2-api-lambda-role and reloop2-post-confirmation-role (inline policies are removed with the role). Data Storage (ap-southeast-1): Delete DynamoDB table reloop2-core-table. Empty and delete both S3 buckets: reloop2-images-<suffix> and reloop2-web-<suffix>. Finish Global Edge (Global / us-east-1): Once CloudFront <dist-id> shows Disabled + Deployed, delete the distribution. Delete CloudFront Origin Access Control reloop2-web-oac and Functions reloop2-spa-rewrite + reloop2-api-prefix. Open AWS WAF & Shield -> Global (CloudFront) -> delete Web ACL reloop2-web. CloudFront Distributions list confirming reloop2 distribution deleted AWS WAF Global Web ACLs list confirming reloop2-web deleted Part B — Verify Zero Leftover reloop2 Resources via AWS CLI Run this quick read-only check in your terminal and confirm every command returns []:
aws cloudfront list-distributions --query "DistributionList.Items[?contains(Comment || '', 'reloop2')].Id" aws wafv2 list-web-acls --scope CLOUDFRONT --region us-east-1 --query "WebACLs[?contains(Name,'reloop2')].Name" aws s3api list-buckets --query "Buckets[?contains(Name,'reloop2')].Name" aws dynamodb list-tables --region ap-southeast-1 --query "TableNames[?contains(@,'reloop2')]" aws cognito-idp list-user-pools --max-results 60 --region ap-southeast-1 --query "UserPools[?contains(Name,'reloop2')].Name" aws apigatewayv2 get-apis --region ap-southeast-1 --query "Items[?contains(Name,'reloop2')].Name" aws lambda list-functions --region ap-southeast-1 --query "Functions[?contains(FunctionName,'reloop2')].FunctionName" aws bedrock list-guardrails --region ap-southeast-1 --query "guardrails[?contains(name,'reloop2')].name" aws events list-rules --region ap-southeast-1 --query "Rules[?contains(Name,'reloop2')].Name" aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --region ap-southeast-1 --query "MetricAlarms[?contains(AlarmName,'reloop2')].AlarmName" aws sns list-topics --region ap-southeast-1 --query "Topics[?contains(TopicArn,'reloop2')].TopicArn" Part C — Terraform Infrastructure-as-Code Reference If you prefer reproducible Infrastructure as Code over manual Console clicks, clone the companion repository github.com/madlyham/ReLoop. Its modular terraform/ directory models this exact 12-service architecture (provider.tf, data.tf, variables.tf, frontend.tf, security.tf, identity.tf, api.tf, storage.tf, ai.tf, events.tf, monitoring.tf, outputs.tf) and references the included zips/ and cloudfront-functions/ directly:
git clone https://github.com/madlyham/ReLoop.git cd ReLoop/terraform cp terraform.tfvars.example terraform.tfvars # Edit terraform.tfvars (bucket_suffix, alert_email, origin_verify_secret) terraform init terraform plan terraform apply After terraform apply finishes, return to the repository root (cd ..), run python frontend/configure.py with the printed Cognito outputs, and sync frontend/build/ to the S3 web bucket (see the repository README). When finished, empty both S3 buckets, set cognito_deletion_protection = "INACTIVE" in terraform.tfvars, run terraform apply first to disable deletion protection on the User Pool, and then run terraform destroy.
Part D — Troubleshooting, Lessons Learned & Future Roadmap Issues Encountered & How We Solved Them # Issue Encountered Root Cause How We Solved It 1 IAM Role creation denied (AccessDenied) Team account IAM policy requires a permissions boundary on every newly created application role. Attached the required permissions boundary (TeamAppRoleBoundary) to both reloop2-api-lambda-role and reloop2-post-confirmation-role. 2 API Gateway routes failed with /api prefix mismatch CloudFront routes /api/* to the API Gateway origin, while backend routes are registered without the /api prefix (e.g. /feed/public). Added CloudFront Function reloop2-api-prefix on the /api/* behavior to strip /api at the edge before forwarding to API Gateway. 3 Direct API Gateway calls bypassed CloudFront & WAF Default execute-api endpoints remain publicly reachable unless explicitly locked to CloudFront. Configured CloudFront to send the x-origin-verify secret header and verified it in reloop2-api with constant-time timingSafeEqual, rejecting direct calls with 403 DIRECT_ACCESS_FORBIDDEN. 4 Bedrock invocation in Singapore & prompt injection in photo text Cross-region model routing and untrusted text printed on device labels posed reliability and prompt-injection risks. Used global.moonshotai.kimi-k3 via Converse API in ap-southeast-1 and screened Rekognition-extracted text through Amazon Bedrock Guardrail (apac.guardrail.v1:0) before LLM analysis. 5 26% 5xx errors under 80-request burst load test Account Lambda concurrency started at 10, saturating workers before throttling could shape burst traffic. Raised Lambda concurrency to 1,000, configured API Gateway throttling (20 req/s, burst 50), and attached CloudFront WAF per-IP rate limits returning clean 429 responses — eliminating 5xx errors on re-test. Future Roadmap Custom Email Delivery with Amazon SES: Move beyond Cognito’s default ~50 emails/day sender limit to a verified Amazon SES domain for public sign-ups and notifications. Real-Time WebSocket Chat: Replace the current 5-second HTTP chat polling with Amazon API Gateway WebSocket APIs for instant buyer–seller messaging and offers. GitHub Actions OIDC Terraform CD: Automate terraform plan on pull requests and approved terraform apply runs using keyless GitHub Actions OIDC credentials. Multi-City Expansion: Expand ReLoop beyond Ho Chi Minh City using the existing location-agnostic geohash + Haversine matching engine and modular Terraform stacks.
